name: Forbs & herbs
description: Broad-leaved herbs of the steppe and forest floor - Acaena, Senecio, the giant rhubarb Gunnera (nalca, frutilla del diablo), orchids (Codonorchis, Gavilea) and nettles. Functional group pooling 33 source nodes (26 native, 0 exotic, 7 mixed-origin). Several are eaten only by the rabbit in the source web (e.g. Gunnera tinctoria, Codonorchis lessonii, Gavilea lutea, Tetroncium magellanicus), so removing the rabbit releases them completely from herbivory.
